# Automotive Insight

Automotive Insight is an independent automotive workshop in Shenton Park, Western Australia (Perth metro area).

## About
Specialist servicing for European and Asian vehicles, EVs, and hybrid cars. Family-run workshop with a focus on honest, transparent communication. Your dedicated Service Advisor is your point of contact from first call to collection.

## Services
- Logbook servicing (all makes and models)
- Brakes and suspension
- Auto electrical
- Diagnostics
- Fleet maintenance
- European car specialists
- Asian car specialists
- EV and hybrid servicing
- EV charging and diagnostics
- Air conditioning
- Tyres
- DOT vehicle inspections

## Contact
Phone / SMS: 0482 097 182
Hours: Monday–Friday 7:30am–5:00pm
Location: Shenton Park, WA
